pandas.Series.rank

pandas 3.1.1 · Series and accessors · method

Assign positions in sorted order and choose how to handle ties.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

Series.rank(
    axis=0,
    method='average',
    numeric_only=False,
    na_option='keep',
    ascending=True,
    pct=False,
)
